_comment: ORRERY No.7 — UI-FIDELITY-2 W3 flagship showcase (5 hubs). Generated by scripts/build-orrery-graph.mjs; assets under /prism-mock/orrery (fal.ai, vision-critiqued). hub (singular) kept for wire-compat = hubs[0].

hub.title: Arrival
hub.caption: The timepiece floats in deep space over the brass orrery rings — molten headline, drifting dust, scroll descends toward the movement.

hubs.title: Arrival
hubs.caption: The timepiece floats in deep space over the brass orrery rings — molten headline, drifting dust, scroll descends toward the movement.

hubs.title: The Movement
hubs.caption: Exploded mechanism — generated gears and tourbillon turning as real lit 3D over macro photography.

hubs.title: Materia
hubs.caption: Brass, sapphire, meteorite — material swatches with magnetic pointer physics and the molten pour video moment.

hubs.title: Celestia
hubs.caption: The planetarium — stone planets orbit a brass armillary under the star field; click a planet to relight the system.

hubs.title: Acquire
hubs.caption: The closing beat — the timepiece on its obsidian pedestal under a single warm key; eleven made, one is yours.

hubs.title: The Atelier
hubs.caption: The workshop — the cinematic flythrough decelerates and the orrery components detach into your hands. Choose every part, finish and complication; build your ORRERY live in one lit volume.

hubs.title: Aurora Skincare
hubs.caption: A photographic diorama landing page in a single teal hue.

intent.caption: Central brass armillary gear — the heart of the orrery, turning in real 3D over the planetarium.

ORRERY No.7 — the Celestia orrery complication. A miniature solar system rendered in real 3D: an emissive sun with an additive glow shell at centre, four photoreal PBR planets (brass, marble, ice-world, obsidian) orbiting on tilted brass rings with true depth (planets pass behind the sun). Spin time and the planets orbit; drag, or window.__ORRERY__ (setTime/setSpeed/scrub), drives the clockwork of the heavens. The same motif as the Atelier watch dial-art (SC-V-O3).
Celestial story copy. ⋄ A feature-body element on the Celestia page; reading "The mean-solar display tracks the eight planets to a single day in ...". No click behavior.

textContent:
The mean-solar display tracks the eight planets to a single day in two thousand years —
a celestial movement, scaled to the wrist.
